name: Manna Dudley Case
background: Manna Case, also listed as Manna Dudley Case, of Johnson County ran in the 2026 Democratic contest for county treasurer, advanced to the November general election, and lost the general election. The Buffalo Bulletin reported that she received 306 votes in the general election, while Republican Brittnee Borgialli received 3,247. No public-record occupation, education, or military service was found in the official Johnson County election results or the other public records reviewed for this Profile.
